title: Orbit Changelog
description: New features, careful improvements, and fixes from the team building Orbit.

items.title: Launch — Projects that explain themselves
items.content_html:
Projects bring related work, decisions, and updates into one calm shared space.

What’s included

  • A focused project overview
  • Milestones with clear owners
  • A lightweight decision log
Context should travel with the work.

Projects are available today for every workspace.
items.content_text: Projects bring related work, decisions, and updates into one calm shared space.

items.title: Improvement — Search feels instant
items.content_html: Search now returns useful results sooner, keeps keyboard focus predictable, and makes long excerpts easier to scan.

items.title: Fix — Interrupted uploads recover cleanly
items.content_html: Large uploads now resume from a safe checkpoint and surface a clearer recovery action when a network disappears.
